proof_body:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
    push_cast
    have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hy : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 + 1 := by positivity
    have sx := Real.sq_sqrt hx
    have sy := Real.sq_sqrt hy
    have px : 0 < Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have py : 0 < Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have ne : Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) + Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have t : 1 / (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) + Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1)) = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) - Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    rw [t]
    ring
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, 1 / (Real.sqrt (k : ℝ) + Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) + 1)) = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1
